title: Exploring Intrinsic Normal Prototypes within a Single Image for Universal Anomaly Detection (INP-Former)
mechanism: Normal prototypes are extracted from the test image itself and guide a decoder to reconstruct only normal tokens; residual is the anomaly map, so no aligned external reference is needed.
adaptation: Train on clean pool cells across all sources and layouts; on E1 half-cut cells (no train references) the within-cell finger/busbar pattern serves as normality; use the map as a recall prior for inactive and crack components missed by the house model.
min_experiment: Offline: on CV folds, F51, H36, fraction of house-missed (p<0.001) crack/inactive components recovered at 1% flagged area; then logit fusion vs baseline PF ensemble; kill if < 30% recovered or fused relP@2 falls more than relR@2 rises. Under 5 GPU-h.
evidence: R: SOTA single-class, multi-class and few-shot AD on MVTec-AD, VisA, Real-IAD; some zero-shot ability. No EL evidence.
prior_overlap: none (anomaly-detection priors listed as never tried in section 5)
